description: Independently authored Buzz semantic-role test inventory for generated theme CSS. Role names are public API/source identifiers. Direct pairs assume an opaque fill; use overlay recipes whenever resolved alpha is below 1.

measurement.sourceOver: For each layer, effective alpha = parsed fill alpha * opacity. Composite each sRGB channel as src*alpha + dst*(1-alpha), then compute luminance/APCA from the composited result. Resolve nested recipe layers bottom to top.
measurement.animationSampling: Opacity samples cover the envelope; they are not equally spaced animation timestamps. Contrast may be non-monotonic for chromatic fills, so a denser sweep is suitable when intermediate samples approach thresholds.
measurement.transparentBacking: Compact/unboxed messages expose the feed panel. A supplied transparent page/thread host must provide its actual backing.
measurement.foregroundAlpha: Composite partially transparent foreground ink over its measured background before luminance.

notes: Generic affordance-selected uses generic row/control inks; dedicated selected inks apply only to their dedicated navigation/control/sidebar surfaces.
Selected popover menu entries keep generic standard/subtle/metadata inks. Highlighted floating rows promote supporting copy to standard.
Code/table/revealed-spoiler neutral insets reset own-message link/mention/icon pairing and retain opaque panel backing above the bubble highlight.
Own-message mentions override the self-mention token trio as well; test own plus self through the own mention recipe.
Current source has no fixed 8%,12%, or other alpha for message highlights. Alpha comes from the resolved role plus the full-strength animation envelope.
This role graph does not claim pixel geometry or state distinguishability from contrast alone. Validate cues and actual component selectors separately.
CSS Module class names in source are descriptive anchors, not stable global external-plugin selectors.
Do not apply text thresholds to inactive controls or decorative separators; a meaningful control boundary or state mark uses the nontext target.
Theme mode matrix: color/mono/neutral times light/dark and Auto resolved to both modes, including live host mode changes and scoped light/dark popup owners.
Semantic statuses are separate from decorative monochrome. Decide their policy explicitly before asserting every generated role has zero chroma.

Five legacy mapped decorative roles are inventoried but not assigned a universal numeric threshold: border-standard, border-primary, border-message-thread, scrollbar-thumb, scrollbar-thumb-quiet. Their actual geometry and purpose determine whether a nontext accessibility boundary test applies.

Hover-backed chip recipes account for translucent mention/reaction fills above the bubble hover color. Native text selection is a paired fill/text override, not an alpha-reduced overlay from these rules.
